30A Escapes presents… “Summer Cottage”, a beautifully designed, family-centered home nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Perfect for making memories together, this coastal retreat features a large private courtyard with a fire feature and fountain, 4 suites, and is located just a 1-min walk from the Sky Pool and fitness center. Only a 7-minute walk to the beach, this vacation home also includes 6 bikes for exploring the charming community. Learn more below… 👇

★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Steps from Sky Pool and fitness center
✔ Private courtyard with a fire feature and tranquil fountain
✔ 7 minute walk to the sugar-white sands
✔ Accommodates up to 10 guests with 3 king suites and a bunk room for 4 with en-suite
✔ Fully equipped kitchen and spacious living area ideal for entertaining
✔ Three large covered porches for reading, relaxing, or sipping your favorite drink
✔ 6 bikes included for exploring Rosemary Beach’s hidden paths and parks

Eager to Read More?
Here Are A Few Kind Words from Our Previous Guests:

⭐ "Great location and house, a little on the small side but the backyard made up for it." – Lindsey W.
⭐ "We loved our stay! Communication was easy, and the house was perfect for all ages in our family." – Courtney W.
⭐ "Great house, incredible location, and so walkable! Would definitely stay here again." – Deanna A.

★☆ LIVING AREA ☆★

Step inside "Summer Cottage" and feel immediately at home with open, light-filled spaces expertly designed for both relaxation and entertainment. Professionally decorated, the living area boasts coastal elegance, offering plenty of room for everyone to gather.

✔ Spacious living area with comfortable seating and tasteful decor
✔ Large flat-screen TV perfect for movie nights
✔ Easy access to the private courtyard

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

The heart of the home is the open-concept kitchen and dining space, ideal for making group meals and sharing family moments.

✔ Fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances and ample counter space
✔ Dining area with seating for 6
✔ Kitchen bar seating for 4

★☆ OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ☆★

Unwind in the charming private courtyard, a serene outdoor space where you can relax with the sounds of trickling water by the fire.

✔ Private courtyard with a cozy fire feature and water fountain
✔ BBQ grill and shaded dining area for 6
✔ Three spacious covered porches perfect for lounging or people-watching
✔ Your stay includes 6 bikes for touring the community

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

Each spacious bedroom is a peaceful retreat, filled with natural light and styled for comfort and relaxation. Enjoy luxurious bedding, Smart TVs, and private en-suite bathrooms for ultimate convenience and ease.

1st Floor:
✔ Primary King Suite: King bed, en-suite bathroom, flat-screen TV, and courtyard access

2nd Floor:
✔ Primary King Suite: King bed, en-suite bath, private balcony access
✔ King Guest Suite: King bed, en-suite bath with walk-in shower
✔ Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin bunk beds with private bathroom

★☆ ROSEMARY BEACH COMMUNITY ☆★

Immerse yourself in the charm and luxury of the Rosemary Beach community, a stunning beachside destination known for its award-winning architecture and idyllic ambiance. Whether you're seeking adventure, relaxation, or romance, this vibrant locale offers something for everyone.

✔ Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architecture
✔ Racquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spots
✔ Multiple parks and greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountains
✔ Fitness Center with massage and yoga

4 RESORT POOLS:
✔ Barbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountain
✔ Coquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflow
✔ Sky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winter
✔ Cabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool and playground nearby

★☆ LOCATION ☆★

Summer Cottage is nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Perfect for making memories together, this coastal retreat is located just a 1-min walk from the Sky Pool and fitness center. Only a 7-minute walk to the beach, this vacation home also includes 6 bikes for exploring the charming community.

✔ Fitness Center and Racquet Club – Steps away
✔ Sky Pool – 1-minute walk
✔ Local Shops and Dining at Barrett Square – 4-minute walk
✔ Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside Destination with Award-Winning Architecture

★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 6 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.
✔ There is an active camera on the carriage house over the courtyard that overlooks the carriage house door.

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★

description: Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Rosemary Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach. Shoppers can check out Pier Park, while everyone can enjoy the natural beauty of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Frank Brown Park and Emerald Coast Mirror Maze are also worth visiting. Swimming offers a great chance to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
